Ritika Banerjee
Senior Data Scientist | Bangalore
ritika.banerjee657@example.com | +91 9545865401 | 60 days

Versatile data scientist with strong product-focused instincts and a track record of delivering production ML systems for finance and analytics platforms. Comfortable owning end-to-end pipelines from data ingestion to deployed PyTorch models, and collaborating across product, engineering and ops to translate business metrics into measurable model improvements.

Experience

Finlytics — Jul 2024 - Present
Senior Data Scientist
- Led development and deployment of a credit-risk scoring model in Python 3 and PyTorch, improving default prediction AUC by 7% and reducing false positives by 12% through feature engineering with pandas and iterative model tuning.
- Built automated ETL and feature pipelines using SQL and pandas, cutting data preparation time from 6 hours to 45 minutes and enabling daily model retraining.
- Collaborated with engineering and ops via Jira and Confluence to productionize model serving on Linux containers, achieving 99.5% inference uptime and SLA-compliant latency.
- Designed and executed backtests and model monitoring dashboards to track drift and performance, triggering retraining workflows when population statistics shifted.

Zentrix Labs — Apr 2017 - Jun 2024
Data Scientist
- Developed deep learning solutions in PyTorch and Python 3 for anomaly detection in time-series telemetry, reducing manual incident alerts by 35% and increasing precision by 18%.
- Implemented data aggregation and feature stores using SQL and pandas to support multiple model variants, improving experiment turnaround by 40%.
- Drove reproducible experiments and model versioning with Linux-based environments, and documented methodologies in Confluence while coordinating releases through Jira.
- Mentored junior engineers on Deep Learning best practices and PyTorch training pipelines, contributing to a 25% improvement in team model delivery velocity.

Projects
- Real-time Fraud Detector: Prototype real-time fraud detection pipeline using Python 3, PyTorch and SQL to score transactions with sub-second latency on Linux, validated on historical datasets with a 9% lift in precision.
- Model Explainability Toolkit: Built internal toolkit in Python 3 and pandas to produce feature importance reports and counterfactual examples for stakeholders, reducing explanation request turnaround from days to hours.
